name: Kettlebell Reverse Lunge to Knee Drive
description: Hold the bell in a goblet or single-arm rack position and step one leg back into a reverse lunge, dropping the back knee toward the floor. Drive explosively out of the lunge and bring that back knee forward and UP into a balanced knee drive — standing tall on the front leg for a beat — before stepping back into the next lunge. The reverse lunge builds single-leg strength; the knee drive adds power, balance, and hip-flexor work, and exposes any wobble in the standing leg. Stay tall through the torso, control the descent, and drive through the front heel. Complete the reps on one side, then switch.
